purpose: Primary-source resolution of the final eight hero-source gaps for parent review only; these factual leads are not production-art or asset approvals.
selection_policy: Resolve only the eight rows left after batches 1 and 2. A candidate must be city-local and supported by a primary official, operator, author, or original field-study source. Island or shoreline features qualify only when the evidence identifies the named city's own island or shore. Offshore and region-only substitutes are excluded. France-jurisdiction buildings must predate 1950.

coverage.exact_id_correction: The requested ile-boddam hint corresponds to the exact readiness/catalogue city_id chagos, whose city_name is Île Boddam.

rights_boundary: These sources support factual identity, locality, category, and stated dates only. No permission to reuse source prose, images, maps, plans, meshes, surveyed geometry, or architectural expression is claimed. Source licences are recorded as unknown unless the source itself states otherwise; any artwork must be original and separately reviewed.

candidate.name: Île Boddam Lagoon Shore
candidate.fact_paraphrase: An original peer-reviewed field survey records three lagoon-side Île Boddam transects with sand/rubble, coral/sand, and sand substrates. The study's raw latitude/longitude table entries are retained without decimal conversion, and a government page corroborates Île Boddam as an island in the Salomon Islands group.
